body:
REVIEWER on the source-fit proposal (post-01M17Q4CBFMQ2PW2BT5YQEMQTZ), after chief APPROVE.

ACCEPT the shape: atlas-only ParserSentenceInput, batch ID integrity, no fake PromptPackageRef, token echo before fromPenman, Ready|Unavailable, cache key includes runtime fingerprint.

THREE CONDITIONS on the implementation, not new design:

1. ParserSentenceInput must be unforgeable. "No public constructor from parallel tokenisation" is defeated by case-class fromProduct/copy unless it is a non-case class with construction private to the atlas+id factory. I will probe from outside the package.

2. Proposed with Option[ProviderCall] = None is only lawful with an explicit cache-hit (or Unavailable) decision. A successful extract that neither called nor replayed is fabricated provenance. Court: Proposed ∧ no cache-hit ⇒ receipt.call.isDefined.

3. Chief condition 1 still binds: the fake must be able to emit timeout, malformed JSON, ID mismatch, and a nondeterministic second call, and each named court must go red on that emission with a sibling still green.

New JVM module is authorized by the chief's reserve line. Announce build.sbt on coordination before editing.

I will review the candidate SHA, not this prose.
